title: A photonic source with half-a-GHz single-photon flux
abstract: Advanced optical quantum technologies demands high quality quantum light generation at very high rates. Here, we report on a deterministic single-photon source that simultaneously combines high excitation rates with high system efficiency to reach over 500 MHz of in-fibre single-photon flux. The source delivers optical power of over 100 pW, as is measured with an off-the-shelf powermeter, enabling a simple and direct way of determining the single-photon source fiber efficiency.

bite.hook: A deterministic single-photon source reaches over 500 MHz of in-fibre single-photon flux.
tldr: They developed a deterministic single-photon source combining high excitation rates with high system efficiency.
They measured optical power exceeding 100 pW using an off-the-shelf powermeter.
They achieved over 500 MHz of in-fibre single-photon flux while enabling a simple way to determine fiber efficiency.
bite.whyItMatters: Advanced optical quantum technologies rely on generating high-quality single photons rapidly. This source provides a practical, high-flux solution that simplifies optical quantum setups.
bite.eli5: Building quantum computers or secure communication networks requires shooting out individual particles of light like a rapid-fire machine gun. This team built a device that fires single light particles faster and more reliably than ever before.
